Our latest hotel embodies the comfort of home and the luxury of a palace. The amenities include the Salmon Run restaurant, the Nexus Cafe, and 50 premier rooms including families and suites. The hotel sits along the Hoan Kiem Lake just a few steps away from major attractions, shopping, the night – weekend market and historical landmarks. Our restaurants, the Salmon Run and the Nexus Cafe, are conveniently located on the 2nd floor. They provide the freshest seafood, authentic Vietnamese cuisine and Western favorites. The added touches of 24 hour customer service, daily turn down service, and free high speed WI-Fi, flat screen TV with cable and DVD will ensure a memorable stay. Upon your arrival to the Hanoi Emerald Waters Hotel & Spa you will be pampered by our welcoming service and treated to sumptuous delights. * About the Golden Sun Hospitality Team The brand was found in 2006 by the owners Mrs. Moon, Armed with a burning passion to serve guests who wish to stay in the most luxurious, convenient and completely modern space with the perfect quality of service by staff who will do anything and everything in their power of make your stay more enjoyable and memorable. For these reasons Golden Sun Hospitality Group was born. Every single member of our team from managers to staffs is really hard worked, well trained and passion to bring the best to our guests * About the founder Mrs. Moon Pham As said above, she is Moon Pham, was born in 15th July, 1980.
